verdict.rationale: Zep's own open-source Graphiti framework is documented as a way to build and query a Context Graph locally, with entity extraction, temporal modeling and hybrid retrieval. The pricing page also lists a 'Your VPC' deployment option alongside Cloud. However, the main Zep memory product is installed as `zep-cloud`, and nothing in the evidence shows fully offline operation. missing for 10: evidence that Graphiti or Zep works with local LLMs and embedding models, documentation of an embedded in-process mode or its local storage requirements, confirmation that no cloud dependency remains, independent hands-on corroboration of fully local deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the memory layer fully locally — embedded in-process or against local models — without any cloud dependency

citations.quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework. Use it to build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally
